# Arab Fingers

> Arab Fingers (عرب فنجرز) is a free bilingual resource that helps
> families teach the Arabic alphabet to children aged 1–6. It combines an interactive
> letter game, printable worksheets, and in-depth guides written by a parent-developer,
> with natural Arabic + English pronunciation. No accounts, no profiling, nothing
> personal collected; advertising appears on parent-facing reading pages only,
> never on the games a child plays.

Maintained by Aissa Trad. Contact: ibhartech39@gmail.com
Languages: English (en), Arabic (ar). Base URL: https://www.arabfingers.site

## Interactive tools
- Letter game (keyboard smash): https://www.arabfingers.site/en/play
- Coloring & tracing: https://www.arabfingers.site/en/coloring
- Printable worksheets: https://www.arabfingers.site/en/printables
